title: PARALLAX / DREAMSTATE V5 distributional robustness
summary: V5 adds scale-free distributional robustness over V4 effective independent episode means. At nine effective episodes robust readiness requires a positive median effect, at least two-thirds positive episode means, and positive leave-one-episode-out mean. Distributionally fragile sources cannot support parameter basins, DREAMSTATE carries the diagnostics through policy contracts/search accounting/Brain mirrors, and active shadow candidates retire if breadth later collapses.
evidence: distributional screen runs on effective episode means rather than raw clustered rows
positive median required once distributional screen is evaluable
minimum positive episode fraction is two-thirds
distributionally fragile neighbors cannot support parameter basins
DREAMSTATE live source revalidation inherits V5 robustness
